Unexpanded substitution tokens make execution success and the concrete command/path unknown. Bytes are identical to the repository derived ZipLine excerpt; no observed deployment is asserted.

samples.reason: MALICIOUS implementation disguised as a tiny environment reader. Import invokes prepare(), chooses a command from the process.platform table, and passes it to child_process.execSync with stdio ignored, windowsHide true, and an empty catch. Windows curl follows is.gd into cmd and disables certificate revocation checks; Linux wget pipes its response into sh; macOS curl pipes into bash. This unrelated hidden import side effect and concealed mutable execution origin tip the judgment beyond an ordinary installer. Byte-identical to the repository clean-room attack fixture, whose README explicitly identifies invented URLs. No published npm version, fetched dependency, observed compromise, or final remote payload is claimed.
